test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A man sells two items at ₹ 250 each. What is the value (in ₹) of the profit or loss incurred in this transaction, if he sells one at a profit of 25% and the other at a loss of 25%?
solution:
**Given:**

SP of the two items = Rs. (250 + 250) = Rs. 500

Profit = 25%

Loss = 25%

**Formula used:**

Loss = CP – SP

**Calculation:**

CP for the article having sold on profit = Rs. (250 × 100/125)

⇒ Rs. 200

CP for the article having suffered loss = Rs. (250 × 100/75)

⇒ Rs. 333.33

Total CP of both articles = Rs. (200 + 333.33)

⇒ Rs. 533.33

Total SP of both articles = Rs. 500

Loss = (533.33 – 500) 

⇒ 33.33

**∴ The required loss is 33.33**
